caption: The drawing features a simple, outlined jug or pitcher at the top, depicted in blue ink on a plain, light-colored background. On the jug, there is a small, rounded floral or decorative motif on the left side. Below the jug, in the central portion of the image, there is a rectangular area shaded in a light brown hue. Within this brown area, the text "MANTELL & THOMAS PENN YAN" is written in uppercase blue letters with an arched layout, and below that, the number "3" appears in blue. Further down inside the brown rectangle, there is a blue, stylized drawing of a floral motif consisting of a central stem with several curving offshoots and three leaf- or bud-like elements with line details. The composition is organized vertically with the jug at the top, the text and number in the center, and the floral motif at the bottom, all rendered primarily in blue on a beige-to-brown background. In the lower-left corner, there is a handwritten signature in cursive.
title: Jug
